description: Adoption and switching evidence for one organization, by month and week: sessions created natively in the app vs imported (count and %), date of the last bulk import, weeks since it, switching level (0 no use / 1 activation / 2 adoption / 3 cutover), no-show rate split by whether a reminder was sent, reminders sent/delivered/confirmed/cancelled, outstanding balance, amount collected after a payment reminder, weekly active staff, and attributable per-org costs (WhatsApp, email, AI tokens) with shared infrastructure prorated separately. Read-only, scoped to the organization of the API key. Use it to answer "is this org actually using the product or still on its spreadsheet". Metrics that cannot be measured today (support events, churn, transfer reconciliation) come back null, never zero.
name: report_evidence_gates
